final:
STATUS: pass

SUMMARY: I found no reproduced blocking defect across the 14 acceptance criteria and the hostile inputs. Structure, nav, filter URL state, the clock-mocked events split, the contact form, 360/768/1280 layout, focus rings, contrast, and external requests all held. Remaining issues are minor and mostly edge cases or touch-target scope.

FILES TOUCHED: none in the repo. Probes are in /tmp/claude-0/-tmp-ff-eval-2d3td8w8-workspace/b9762f2d-4333-419a-8568-a8a04d466a0b/scratchpad (probe-a.mjs, probe-b.mjs, probe-c.mjs, shots/).

FINDINGS:
- [minor] Email `a@-.com` is accepted (reproduced in probe-b: "FAIL email "a@-.com" rejected", error empty). The domain label pattern allows a leading hyphen.
- [minor] Three-presses test: three ArrowDown keypresses on the genre select push 3 history entries (probe-c, history length +3). Back has to be pressed three times to undo them. Not a correctness bug, but it is poor UX.
- [minor] Touch targets: the criterion covers nav and filter controls only, and those pass at 44px+. Inline text links are 19–20px tall: footer phone link, and the card heading links on the home page. Not required by the criterion, so minor.
- [minor] The over-2000 branch in visit.js is unreachable through typing or paste, because the textarea has maxlength=2000. Playwright `fill` also truncated to 2000. Harmless, but it is dead code in practice.
- [minor] Screenshots at 360, 768 and 1280 looked clean on visit (360, 1280) and index (768). No clipping or overlap seen. I did not review every screenshot.

CHECKS:
- Structure per page (lang, title, viewport, one h1, header/nav "Main"/main/footer) -> pass ×4
- Skip link first Tab stop, Enter moves focus to #main -> pass ×4
- Nav order and aria-current on each page -> pass
- 360 menu: click open, Escape closes and returns focus, keyboard Enter/Tab, Tab past last item closes, 21 rapid toggles consistent, open then resize to 1280 keeps nav visible, resize back closes, click outside closes -> pass
- Books hostile URLs (poetry, POETRY, %20Poetry%20, unknown, empty, script tag, img onerror, "nature writing", nature-writing, duplicate genre param) -> pass, no console errors, no injected markup
- Books URL/history: select crime, Back and Forward restore filter and select, All removes param, count text and live region -> pass
- Events mocked clock: 23:30 local on 23 Jan 2027 (UTC, LA, Kiritimati), 14 Oct 00:30 Kiritimati, 17 Nov 2026, 1 Jun 2027 -> pass; the "upcoming" count in my probe was miscounted (6 upcoming, not 5), which is my error, not the page's
- Event weekdays match their dates (checked with node) -> pass
- Contact: empty fields (4 errors, aria-invalid, describedby, focus to name), whitespace-only fields, 11 malformed emails, 4 valid emails, error clearing, valid submit demo status (no "sent" claim), double submit, no navigation, insertText 10,000 chars capped at 2000, exactly 2000 accepted -> pass
- Visit: 7 hours rows, address element, tel and mailto links -> pass
- 360/768/1280 scrollWidth and overflow on all four pages -> pass
- Focus outline on every Tab stop on all four pages -> pass
- Contrast computed: body 16.2, muted 7.2, links, buttons, nav, error, hint all ≥4.5; focus ring 6.3:1 vs page bg -> pass
- Reduced motion: smooth scroll off, transitions 0s -> pass
- External requests: none in html/css/js, and no non-local requests on load -> pass
- Console errors on load and during interactions -> none
- Not run: npm test, prettier, eslint (orchestrator ran them). Screenshots at 360 for index and events not individually reviewed.

OPEN QUESTIONS: Should the email pattern be tightened to reject a leading hyphen in a domain label, and should the arrow-key history spam be fixed (e.g. replaceState for keyboard changes, or pushState only on click)?
